semantics.counting: distinct signed execution IDs with distinct output digests
semantics.freshness: all counted records within window relative to verifier-supplied time
semantics.trust: verifier supplies trusted runtime and external attester keys
semantics.unsupported_requirements: fail closed; never award checked status
semantics.attestations: claims must bind the output digest; local command names are not attestations
semantics.evidence_status: PENDING is catalog metadata, not an evaluated count of available records. CHECKED requires a verifier, trusted keys, freshness, distinct evidence and every requirement.
semantics.market_scope: User-provided job taxonomy; no labor-market statistics or 2026 demand claims independently validated.
semantics.policy_scope: Thresholds and time windows are proposed policies. Related skill IDs are not interchangeable and do not imply one another.
semantics.definition_identity: Consumers must bind ontology schema, catalog version and content digest; skill IDs alone do not freeze policy. Version 5 adds supply-chain transparency, hardware-rooted attestation, verifiable computation and agent-runtime evidence lanes while retaining prior IDs.
semantics.transparency: Attestations MAY be registered with a Transparency Service (SCITT, RFC 9943) or a Rekor-compatible log. A transparency receipt is evidence of registration, not of truth; it MUST be evaluated alongside the signed statement.
semantics.sbom_binding: SBOM predicates MUST bind the subject artifact digest. CycloneDX and SPDX are accepted formats; a bare SBOM without digest binding is not attestation evidence.
semantics.formal_isolation: Negative isolation tests MAY be complemented by a formal analyzer proof or a reproducing counterexample. A solver result without a bound schema digest and tool version is not attestation evidence.
semantics.agent_runtime: Arkhe proposed agent evidence requires signed tool contracts and session-bound runtime evidence; these are local policy requirements, not guarantees supplied by MCP itself.
semantics.predicate_families: predicate_families lists compatible families, not implicit conjunction. family_policy specifies required conjunctions or alternatives. Unsupported family policies remain PENDING.

attestation_contract.subject_binding: Each Arkhe claim binds execution ID, output digest and source identity. In an in-toto Statement the artifact digest is in Statement.subject, not inside predicate. External SLSA verification alone does not establish an Arkhe claim contract.
attestation_contract.signing: Verifier signature must bind all required fields under a versioned domain-separated encoding; embedded keys alone are not trusted. DSSE envelopes are accepted when payloadType is application/vnd.in-toto+json and signatures are over the PAE.
attestation_contract.result: exit_code must be zero; report must contain claim-specific measurements or findings; command names and URLs alone never satisfy claims.
attestation_contract.coverage: cargo-test-coverage requires an attached report naming measured scope, measurement tool/version, covered/total counts and explicit threshold; running cargo test alone is insufficient.
attestation_contract.freshness: Verifier-supplied time and trust policy govern freshness and accepted signing keys; missing or future timestamps fail closed. Transparency receipts and Rekor checkpoints MUST be fresh relative to verifier time.
attestation_contract.transparency: When transparency is required, the attestation MUST be accompanied by either (a) a SCITT receipt from a trusted Transparency Service or (b) a Rekor inclusion proof + checkpoint signed by a trusted log key. The verifier MUST evaluate the receipt/proof against the statement digest, not against a detached claim.
attestation_contract.sbom: When an SBOM claim is evaluated, the SBOM predicate MUST be digest-bound to the subject artifact. CycloneDX and SPDX are accepted. A raw SBOM file without digest binding fails closed.
attestation_contract.hardware_attestation: Hardware evidence requires a profile-specific verifier, trusted endorsements/root, accepted measurements and verifier freshness. DICE/X.509/COSE encodings are profile-specific; no universal RISC-V quote wire format is assumed.
attestation_contract.verifiable_computation: When a zkVM/STARK receipt is evaluated, the verifier MUST know the allowed program_digest and verifier_key_digest. output_digest MUST bind the claimed output. A proof without program binding fails closed.
attestation_contract.agent_evidence: When agent runtime evidence is evaluated, PreToolUse and PostToolUse MUST be gated, the nonce MUST be session-bound or verifier-supplied, and fail_mode MUST be deny. A tool contract without a signature over the canonical digest is not evidence.
attestation_contract.missing_or_unsupported: PENDING; no CHECKED result. No parser or evaluator for this contract is implemented yet.

evidence_predicate_families.description: Base in-toto Statement envelope. Required fields: _type (https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1), subject (name + digest map), predicateType, predicate.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: subject[*].digest binds the tested artifact or output digest.
evidence_predicate_families.signing: Wrapped in a DSSE envelope (payloadType application/vnd.in-toto+json) or equivalent domain-separated signature. Signatures are over the PAE, not over the raw JSON.

evidence_predicate_families.description: SLSA Build Provenance v1; this catalog uses a restricted verifier profile, not SLSA-level certification. Optional SLSA fields are not globally required.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: Artifact digest belongs to Statement.subject; source dependencies belong to predicate.buildDefinition.resolvedDependencies. Builder and buildType must be pinned by verifier policy.

evidence_predicate_families.description: CycloneDX SBOM as an in-toto predicate. The SBOM JSON body is the predicate; the statement subject MUST carry the manifest digest of the attested artifact.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: subject.digest.sha256 MUST equal the container image or artifact digest the SBOM describes.
evidence_predicate_families.note: cosign attest --type cyclonedx produces this envelope.

evidence_predicate_families.description: SPDX document as an in-toto predicate, digest-bound to the artifact.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: subject.digest.sha256 MUST match the artifact under attestation.

evidence_predicate_families.description: SCITT architecture (RFC 9943); listed fields describe an Arkhe adapter plan, not a normative SCITT wire receipt. Native signed statements/receipts need a dedicated verifier.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: statement_digest MUST bind the DSSE envelope or statement digest that was registered.
evidence_predicate_families.scope: A SCITT receipt does not assert that the statement is true; it asserts that the statement was notarized. It MUST be evaluated together with the underlying signed statement.

evidence_predicate_families.description: Sigstore Rekor inclusion proof + checkpoint. Proves an entry is part of a tamper-evident Merkle tree at a given tree size.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: The leaf hash MUST bind the signature or DSSE envelope under evaluation.
evidence_predicate_families.verification: Verifier MUST check the checkpoint signature against a trusted Rekor key and MUST require a consistency proof or witness quorum when the checkpoint is newer than the entry's witness.

evidence_predicate_families.description: DICE is an attestation architecture with profile-specific certificate/claim encodings. No universal RISC-V CoVE quote format is asserted here; vendor/profile verification remains pending.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: The Alias key signature MUST cover the quote body containing measurements and freshness/report data. The chain MUST anchor in a trusted RoT public key.

evidence_predicate_families.description: Verifiable computation receipt from a zkVM/STARK prover. Proves that a computation was executed correctly without revealing private inputs.
evidence_predicate_families.binding: output_digest MUST bind the execution output being claimed; program_digest MUST bind the exact program/ circuit under evaluation.
evidence_predicate_families.note: The verifier MUST know the allowed verifier_key_digest and proof_system ahead of time; a proof alone does not establish which circuit it proves.
evidence_predicate_families.privacy_limit: Verifiable execution does not automatically imply zero knowledge; privacy depends on the selected proof system and its configuration.

evidence_predicate_families.description: Cryptographically signed, content-addressed tool contract for AI agents (e.g. Glyph Protocol or an equivalent signed MCP tool card).
evidence_predicate_families.binding: canonical_digest MUST bind the full contract; tool_schema_digest MUST bind the executable schema. Runtime execution receipts MUST reference this digest.
evidence_predicate_families.standardization: Arkhe proposed profile, not a normative MCP or external industry standard.

evidence_predicate_families.description: Sealed runtime evidence from an agent runtime (e.g. AgentHook runtime attestation).
evidence_predicate_families.binding: nonce MUST be verifier-supplied or session-bound; gated_events MUST cover PreToolUse and PostToolUse for any tool execution claim.
evidence_predicate_families.fail_closed: Runtime evidence MUST fail closed on missing gates or invalid signatures.
evidence_predicate_families.standardization: Arkhe proposed profile, not a normative MCP or external industry standard.
